line.name: E.P. Carrillo INCH Limited Edition 2019
line.background_text: Released to commemorate E.P. Carrillo's tenth anniversary, only the second limited-edition INCH release after the 2014 INCH Short Run. Connecticut Habano wrapper (chosen for performance at large ring gauges) over Nicaraguan binder/filler, single oversized Super Gordo vitola with distinctive anniversary banding.

vitolas.summary_review: Medium-to-medium-full with coffee, earth, red pepper, cream, and fruit notes building through a balanced final third.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Buy One; coffee, earth, red pepper, cream, fruit; $15.00; medium to medium-full.

research_notes: Confirmed genuinely distinct limited edition - unique wrapper and single-vitola format, clearly separate from standard INCH variants.

research_sources.supports: blend, vitola, score, tasting notes, price
